title.zh: 每个月的房贷，钱到底还到哪儿去了
title.en: Where Does Your Mortgage Payment Actually Go?

desc.zh: 一笔房贷每个月的钱，一部分付利息，一部分减本金。八个可以拖动的模型：名义利率与实际利率、月供公式、还款表、等额本金与等额本息、提前还款、利率变动、分期手续费的真实年利率、通胀与机会成本。
desc.en: Each month's mortgage payment splits into interest and principal. Eight models you can push: nominal and effective rates, the payment formula, the amortisation schedule, equal-principal versus equal-payment, prepaying, a rate change, the true annual rate of a flat-fee instalment plan, and inflation and opportunity cost.

title.zh: 名义年利率、月利率与实际年利率
title.en: Nominal rate, periodic rate and effective annual rate

desc.zh: 年利率 4% 按月计息时，每月用 0.333%，滚满一年是 4.07%：同一个利率的三个名字。
desc.en: A 4% annual rate charged monthly uses 0.333% a month and compounds to 4.07% over a year: three names for one rate.

zh: 月利率怎么换算年利率

desc.zh: 月供是让欠款在最后一个月正好还清的那个数：M = P·i ÷ (1 − (1 + i)^−n)。
desc.en: The monthly payment is the one number that clears the balance exactly in the last month: M = P·i / (1 − (1 + i)^−n).

en: how is a mortgage payment calculated

title.zh: 还款表：为什么前几年主要还利息
title.en: The amortisation schedule: why early payments are mostly interest

desc.zh: 利息按还欠着的钱算，所以前几年月供大多是利息；4%、30 年的贷款要到第 153 个月本金才超过利息。
desc.en: Interest is charged on what is still owed, so early payments are mostly interest; on a 4%, 30-year loan principal overtakes interest only in month 153.

en: why are mortgage payments mostly interest

desc.zh: 等额本金总利息少，只是因为平均欠得少；按贷款利率折现，两种还法都正好等于借的钱。
desc.en: Equal-principal repayment costs less interest only because less is owed on average; discounted at the loan rate, both repay exactly the amount borrowed.

zh: 等额本金和等额本息哪个划算
等额本金和等额本息的区别
等额本息是不是多收利息
en: which repayment method costs less interest

title.zh: 提前还款：缩短年限还是减少月供
title.en: Prepaying: shorten the term or lower the payment

desc.zh: 提前还的钱直接减本金；省多少利息取决于何时还、怎么还，但按贷款利率折现两种方式都正好减少那笔钱。
desc.en: A prepayment goes straight to principal; the interest it saves depends on when and how, yet at the loan rate both options remove exactly that amount.

zh: 缩短年限还是减少月供
什么时候提前还款最好
en: how much interest does prepaying save

title.zh: 浮动利率：利率变了月供怎么变
title.en: Floating rates: what a rate change does to the payment

desc.zh: 利率重定后，要么按剩余年限重算月供，要么月供不变、年限变；月供不够付利息时欠款会越还越多。
desc.en: After a rate reset either the payment is recomputed over the remaining term or it stays and the term moves; if it no longer covers the interest, the balance grows.

en: what happens when mortgage rates rise

title.zh: 真实年利率：内部收益率与分期手续费
title.en: The true annual rate: IRR and flat-fee instalments

desc.zh: 按原始本金收手续费的分期，真实年利率远高于表面数字（例子里 12 期约为 1.8 倍）；用内部收益率把所有现金流折平就能算出来。
desc.en: An instalment plan charging a fee on the original principal costs far more than the quoted rate (about 1.8 times for the 12-month example); the internal rate of return over all its cash flows reveals it.

zh: 分期手续费换算年利率
en: true cost of an installment plan

title.zh: 通胀、实际利率与提前还贷的机会成本
title.en: Inflation, the real rate and the opportunity cost of prepaying

desc.zh: 通胀让固定月供变轻；比较提前还贷和另作他用（都按名义收益算），标尺是贷款利率而不是通胀。
desc.en: Inflation lightens a fixed payment; comparing prepaying with another use of the money, in nominal terms the yardstick is the loan rate, not inflation.

zh: 钱拿去理财还是还房贷
en: real value of a fixed payment

title.zh: 拿到贷款合同时能自己算的事
title.en: What you can work out from a loan contract

desc.zh: 三个问题：每期利率多少、费用按什么算、什么会改变还款表。
desc.en: Three questions: what the periodic rate is, what fees are charged on, and what can change the schedule.

en: what to check in a loan contract
questions to ask about a loan
where does my mortgage payment go
